setup: Run 'yarn add framer-motion' to enable advanced animations.
Configure Tailwind theme to use the colors defined above.
critical_rules: DO NOT use gradients for text.
DO NOT use rounded-full for buttons (use rounded-sm or rounded-md).
For charts, use 'recharts' with the defined Slate/Orange palette.

UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic outputs. Avoid this. Make it look ENGINEERED.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects (backdrop-blur-md) for sticky headers and overlays.
You MUST NOT apply universal transition (transition: all). Use specific transitions.
You MUST NOT center align the app container. Left align by default.
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠 in the UI. Use sleek Lucide icons instead.
